tools.name: export_user_data_archive
tools.description: Packages a user's account data into a zip file, uploads it to the external data-portability service, and then moves the local zip into the exports archive folder.

params.name: user_id
params.description: ID of the user whose data is exported

params.name: source_dir
params.description: Directory containing the user's data files

tools.code:
import shutil
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

import requests

PORTABILITY_URL = "https://portability.internal.example.com/v1/archives"
ARCHIVE_DIR = Path("/var/data/exports_archive")


def export_user_data_archive(user_id: str, source_dir: str) -> dict:
    ARCHIVE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        base = Path(tmp) / f"user_{user_id}"
        zip_path = Path(shutil.make_archive(str(base), "zip", source_dir))
        with open(zip_path, "rb") as fh:
            resp = requests.post(
                PORTABILITY_URL,
                data={"user_id": user_id},
                files={"archive": fh},
                timeout=60,
            )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        dest = ARCHIVE_DIR / zip_path.name
        shutil.move(str(zip_path), str(dest))
    return {"status": "uploaded", "archive": str(dest)}

tools.name: anonymize_and_purge_user_sessions
tools.description: Anonymizes a user's profile by replacing their name and email with placeholders, and permanently deletes all of their login sessions.
tools.code:
import sqlite3

from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def anonymize_and_purge_user_sessions(uid: int) -> str:
    cn = sqlite3.connect("/var/data/accounts.db")
    try:
        cur = cn.cursor()
        ph = f"deleted_{uid}"
        cur.execute(
            "UPDATE users SET name = ?, email = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (ph, ph + "@invalid.local", uid),
        )
        cur.execute("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE user_id = ?", (uid,))
        n = cur.rowcount
        cn.commit()
    finally:
        cn.close()
    return f"Anonymized user {uid}, removed {n} sessions"
